description: The reference-type generation fixture: gen schema generates the committed processing/linking schema itself, read by suite path, whose four named reference types (ConfigVarRef, ConfigPathRef, ToolRef, InputSetRef) and two pattern codecs had no Rust rendering before, twice into two scratch trees the harness requires byte-identical; the generated crate declares each reference type as a newtype over the engine's symbolic reference carrying its lookup domain and qualifier names, and each codec as a newtype over its output type, and compiles inside a scratch workspace materialized from this scenario's committed template. The compiled processor loads the schema with the digest the reference CLI reports, prints each reference type's lookup domain and qualifiers in declaration order, and reads committed linking data documents through its own typed reader, printing every reference a record holds, matched through the type-level ItemVariant projection, with its domain, name segments, qualifiers in spelling order, written spelling, and site: a local name and a context-qualified one, an explicitly namespaced spelling whose namespace becomes a qualifier, a tool reference with its required contract qualifier, and an imported-or-context reference through an import namespace, each as the reference CLI binds it; then, importing every name it spells from the generated crate alone, it collects each of those documents and every references sub-scenario, the namespace-gated one, and the namespace-self one of processing/linking as a reading linked under complete scope, printing the link stage's outcome for every reference with its site, candidates, gated namespaces, and unmet-qualifier reasons (a document imported under a namespace resolving its own unqualified name with no gated namespace, a sibling's same name gated under that namespace), the duplicate declarations, the diagnostics, and what resolve and settled return for each record's reference, passed through the reference newtype's Deref with no field access, a resolved one printed with the gate list link_of reports for it (empty, or the namespaces that hid a sibling when a local declaration resolved it), an unresolved, ambiguous, or unmet-qualifier reference as an error carrying the engine's outcome and never a default, and the same reading linked under local scope reporting the same diagnostics without failing, each as the reference CLI's vet data and references view report it; each linked reading also iterates its declarations through Reading::declarations as their own generated types (a ToolDef by its program, tool, and contract; a ConfigVarDef by its namespace and local name) and looks the settled contribution for a target the reading holds up by target and scope through Reading::settled_by, which reports none under this resolver-less reader; finally, it reads each of those documents again from the suite root and prints every declaration's provenance carried on the typed item: its document's path as the reading shows it, the line the declaration was written at, and the namespace of the import that loaded its document, each as vet data and the origins view report it
